RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition alone proves nothing. Panels are often skewed by which departments and seniority levels are involved; all-women panels occur by chance reasonably often, and there's no evidence same-sex panels favour their own sex. Raising it makes you look like you're reaching, and it will overshadow your stronger points.

Also, don't underrate her profile. For head of risk modelling at a bank, regulatory experience — model approvals, supervisory engagement, validation standards — is frequently weighted above technical depth, because the role is largely about defending models to regulators. A PhD doesn't automatically outrank that.

Your real grievance is procedural: chase the written reasons in writing, with a deadline, and ask for the scoring against the criteria.
